Kforce has a client that is seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer in Foster City, CA.

Overview:
Within the PMO, the Processes & Tools team builds the internal applications that program managers and engineering teams rely on every day - reporting tools that turn raw Jira data into a clear picture of program health, and planning tools that let teams build a plan in a purpose-built interface and push it back into Jira as tickets and dependencies. We have moved fast and proven the value of these applications with real users, and we are now investing in making them robust, secure, and ready-to-scale. We are looking for an early-career Software Engineer to join us and grow into that work.

Responsibilities:
 
  Build and ship features across our internal applications - frontend and backend - working directly with the program managers who use them 
  Help harden our existing applications for production use, driving work on authentication, error handling, input validation, and safe handling of operations that write data back into Jira 
  Write automated tests for new and existing code, and help grow test coverage on the paths that matter most 
  Drive our CI/CD pipelines and deployment process, and keep our applications running on AWS 
  Investigate and fix bugs reported by users, including tracing problems through logs and monitoring to find root causes 
  Integrate with the Jira APIs, and help make those integrations more resilient to rate limits, timeouts, and partial failures 
  Document what you build, so the next person can operate and extend it without you in the room 
  Partner with non-engineer teammates who prototype using AI-assisted development tools, helping turn their prototypes into something we can support 
 
 
  1-2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrable work - internships, meaningful open-source contributions, or a portfolio of projects you have built and can walk us through in detail 
  Experience with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) design, software architecture design, relational data modeling and admin UI/tooling 
  Experience building with AI-assisted development tools, and a point of view on where they help and where they need care 
  Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and a component framework (React preferred), and the ability to build a functional user interface 
  Working knowledge of Python or Node.js/TypeScript on the backend 
  Exposure to AWS - EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, or IAM 
  Familiarity with Git and collaborative development, including code review 
  Strong fundamentals and a genuine appetite to learn quickly; We care far more about how you reason through an unfamiliar problem than about the length of your technology list 
  Clear communicator who is comfortable working directly with non-engineers; You will be talking to program managers daily, and you will need to explain what you are doing and ask good questions when requirements are vague 
  Comfortable asking for help early and saying when you are stuck or unsure. In a small team this matters more than in a large one 
  A passion for building efficient systems and a knack for making complex processes simple and intuitive for users
